about: The second fix round around the desk: each item has a scenario driven as a user reaches it (scenarios/37-fix-chrome2.mjs), with the older scenarios that pass since.

scenarios.why: RC-01's remainder: on Library, Studios, Training and Settings, F9, Alt+3 and Space do nothing; Ctrl+Z under the notes there says nothing; the top bar's Create is not covered and brings Create back, where F9 works.
E-15: the Modules panel's card, its filter and the picker's info line describe Tempo as its tile holds it on the engine in use (Beat I/O on MiniMax-Music3, a length on ACE-Step).
S-02: under a finger a plugin menu's first tap shows the symbol in the header with Use it, says a second tap uses it, and chooses nothing; the second tap chooses.
14-undo.js: an Undo or Redo that leaves a later edit alone says so; one with nothing of its step left says "Nothing to put back for ..." and why (F-24).
The Modules panel names Tempo on MiniMax-Music3 as its tile does, and describes what it holds there (E-15). (Re-read in the consolidation round, RA-06; it passes since this round.)
Undo puts back the lyrics, keeps the description edited since, and says so. (Re-read in the consolidation round, RA-06; it passes since this round.)
